description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rajanganaya Yaya 01, Rajanganaya D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110177
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including ownership details, parcel numbers, extents, and legal encumbrances. The content is focused on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
